# Solution

When writing a report, you should explain why the product does not fulfill the advertised specifications. For instance, a product specification could be that a battery of Model A could last a month. In testing, if the battery only lasts a week, then the failure was a 75% reduction in performance. Also use relative figures to clarify the degree of discrepancy.
